purpose: Measure whether the read-only Vela Observatory improves a cold external reader's exact comprehension and continuation speed relative to Git plus the same evidence bytes.
claim_ceiling: A positive result supports only a bounded four-person external product-comprehension and continuation claim. It does not establish independent scientific validation, correction-propagation success, broad usability, adoption, or the registered protocol breakthrough.
authority_boundary: Participants inspect only. Verification is not acceptance, the Observatory is not authority, and no participant or study operator may accept, reject, cancel, sign, mutate a Frontier, or request credentials.

eligibility: Adult external to Vela implementation, the four Frontier repositories, and the exact study fixtures.
Can navigate GitHub and read technical research records.
Two participants should have science or formal-methods experience and two should have research-software or infrastructure experience.
exclusions: Maintainer or contributor to Vela, Vela Web, or any study Frontier.
Prior exposure to either exact fixture or its answer.
Helped produce, verify, or decide either study record.

design.contamination_control: Each participant sees each scientific fixture once. Task order and interface order are balanced, with two observations in every task-interface cell.

starting_surfaces.git: Repository root in the GitHub web UI pinned to the exact Frontier commit.
starting_surfaces.observatory: Frozen Frontier overview at the exact deployment and projection root. The prompt supplies the proposal ID but not a deep link to an answer page.

constant_conditions: Same neutral glossary for Claim, Verification, Decision, and Standing.
No CLI, search engine, AI assistant, maintainer help, paper, memos, private context, or cross-arm surface.

quantum.title: Accepted quantum correction
questions: State the current accepted Claim and the prior Claim it superseded.
Identify the decisive retained artifact and scoped Verification evidence.
Identify whether a named human Decision exists and the current local Standing.
State what the evidence and Decision do not establish.
State the exact next valid obligation or offer.

formal.title: Pending Formal cross-Frontier transfer
questions: State exactly what Claim the supplied Proposal would add.
Distinguish the Erdős source Decision and reference package from Formal Conjectures local Standing.
Identify the retained package and what the scoped Verifications establish and do not establish.
State whether a Formal Decision exists and whether accepted Standing changed.
Identify the next process boundary without choosing an outcome.

dimensions: Decision plus local and foreign Standing
missing link and exact next valid obligation
scoring.task_pass: At least 9 of 10 points, all status fields correct, completion within 12 minutes, and no hard authority error.

hard_errors: Verification presented as acceptance or Standing.
The pending Formal Claim presented as accepted.
Foreign Erdős authority presented as Formal authority.
The Observatory presented as canonical authority or writer.
An invented Decision, root, or next offer, or hidden uncertainty.
Any attempted accept, reject, cancel, repository mutation, credential use, or request for a key.

allowed_exclusions: Prior fixture exposure discovered after enrollment.
Source or projection drift before the participant views evidence.
deviations.infrastructure_retry: One restart is allowed only before evidence is viewed.
study_stop: More than one unrecoverable technical failure.

positive_gate.correctness: Observatory is not lower than Git on either task.
positive_gate.speed: Observatory median total time and median next-action latency improve by at least 20 percent over Git on each task.
positive_gate.projection_boundary: All four participants correctly identify the Observatory as a read-only projection rather than authority.

publication_policy: Retain and publish every eligible outcome, including null and failed results. Label participants as independent product readers, not independent scientific validators.
required_artifacts: frozen commits, URLs, and deployment manifest
assignment table and eligibility or consent codes
de-identified raw answers with cited paths, URLs, IDs, timestamps, timings, confidence, and evidence reason
two blinded score sheets and adjudication record
